text:
alex: Noticed increased tail latency from a Private VPC tenant after we tweaked continuous batching heuristics. p95->p99 drift on small-GPU nodes. Anyone have a quick read?

maya: Yup, seeing it on t4s and older p4s with limited mem. Dashboard shows more kernel fallbacks and KV churn.

alex: Paste of a short profiler excerpt from a 20s capture: 
```
kernel_selector: chosen_policy=aggressive_quant
fallbacks: 31 (matmul->fp32_generic)
batch_stats: mean_size=2.6 median_size=2 target_batch_tokens=2048
kv_cache: evict_count=12 prefetch_misses=7
tokens_in_flight: 2200/4096
latency_ms: p50=45 p95=190 p99=540
```

nirav: The aggressive_quant policy is optimizing FLOPs but not stability for odd-sequence shapes. On low-memory GPUs, fallback costs are amplified (allocation + memcpy). We should bias the selector toward conservative kernels in Private clusters with constrained memory.

lisa: We already allow cluster overrides in Private. Proposal: introduce a preset "vpc-stable-serve" that nudges 3 knobs: kernel selection (prefer deterministic kernels), batching token budget (lower), and kv_cache prefetch behavior. Example override snippet: 
```
{"continuous_batching.enabled":"true","continuous_batching.token_budget":"1024","continuous_batching.max_queue_ms":"10","kernel_selector.policy":"stable_vpc","kv_cache.prefetch_jitter_ms":"300","kv_cache.max_evictions_per_min":"2"}
```

maya: That looks sensible. Lower token budget reduces cross-request token mixing and should avoid creating many tiny batches with odd shapes. Also reduce max_queue_ms so we don't wait to assemble weird mixes under low concurrency.

alex: What tradeoffs should we expect? Throughput hit?

nirav: From a local canary on a T4: p99 fell from ~560ms -> ~260ms, p95 from ~200 -> ~120. Throughput dropped ~6-10% (depends on workload). Less jitter and fewer OOM subtle falls. I can attach microbench CSVs to the ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: preset vpc-stable-serve -> canary cluster vpc-eu-1 (deploy id d-20260318-07). Approval required.

lisa: Also adding a small change: disable one fused-quantized matmul path that earlier produced nondeterministic shape handling under quant. We'll gate it under kernel_selector.flags.disable_fused_qmatmul for the preset.

alex: Good. @maya please run a 1hr canary tomorrow morning, capture kernel timelines, KV eviction timeline, and a handful of request traces. Post a summary here with the CSVs attached to the ticket.

maya: Will do. I'll include before/after histograms and the kernel fallback timeline.

nirav: FYI I pushed a tiny prefetch jitter PR that staggers prefetches to avoid eviction storms when many requests restart concurrently. That should be included in the canary bundle.

lisa: Drop PR number here and I'll add it to the canary config.

alex: Thanks all. If canary looks good we'll roll the preset to remaining VPCs with constrained GPUs. Closing thread, will update with canary link.
